✳ Claude CodePrompt 1 · Setup
Hey Claude, set up this project for AI video editing using ElevenLabs for transcription, music and SFX, HyperFrames for motion graphics, FFmpeg for video processing and rendering, browser research for source-based B-roll, and my own screen recordings when needed. Install and verify all dependencies, add the relevant HyperFrames skills, create a .env with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=, add .env to .gitignore. Handle everything yourself and only ask me if you need login, password, admin approval or account authentication.
